summary: A two-year NSTC project building a Taiwan-specific decision-support framework for maritime alternative fuels — hydrogen, ammonia, and green methanol — that integrates Well-to-Wake Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Techno-Economic Analysis (TEA), and Monte Carlo uncertainty simulation to compare imported versus domestically produced fuel supply chains at the Port of Taichung.
summaryZh: 國科會兩年期計畫，建構符合臺灣條件的海運替代燃料決策支援框架，聚焦氫、氨與綠色甲醇，整合油井到艉流（WTW）生命週期評估（LCA）、技術經濟分析（TEA）與蒙地卡羅不確定性模擬，以臺中港為場域比較「海外進口」與「在地生產」兩種供應鏈路徑的環境衝擊與成本。
metaDescription: An NSTC project integrating life cycle assessment, techno-economic analysis, and uncertainty simulation to compare imported versus locally produced hydrogen, ammonia, and green methanol as net-zero marine fuels for Taiwan's ports.
